actions.script: const L = (text) => ec.l10n.localize(text) const enc = (text) => String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, ''') // a /qapps link of this screen with these parameters (recordBase is the screen's own link) const linkTo = (params) => recordBase + '?' + Object.keys(params).filter((key) => params[key] != null && params[key] !== '') .map((key) => encodeURIComponent(key) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(params[key]).replace(/'/g, '%27')).join('&') recordFound = !!rec.found if (!recordFound) return record = rec.record access = rec.access canEdit = !!access.canEdit // the names and channels (emails, phones, websites, addresses): canEdit, or a Sales account editor of the contact // (check#ContactAccess canEditIdentity; impl-sales P4, F98) canEditIdentity = !!access.canEditIdentity isPersonal = !!access.isPersonal // the chatter column beside the overview on a wide full screen; in the split's pane and below 1440 px a tab chatterColumn = !inSplit // two columns of boxes: from 1024 px on the full screen, from 1440 px in the split's narrower pane halfClass = inSplit ? 'col-12 col-lg-6' : 'col-12 col-md-6' avatarUrl = record.hasFaceImage ? sri.buildUrl('contactAvatar').path + '?partyId=' + encodeURIComponent(recordPartyId) : '' // a contact who is a user: the Chat action (a direct message, the one there is or a new one) and the presence dot const chatAccount = Array.from(ec.entity.find('moqui.security.UserAccount').condition('partyId', recordPartyId) .condition(ec.entity.conditionFactory.makeCondition('disabled', 'not-equals', 'Y', true)).selectField('userId').disableAuthz().list()) .find((account) => account.userId !== ec.user.userId) chatUserId = chatAccount ? chatAccount.userId : null chatUrl = chatUserId ? '/qapps/Comms/Chat?dm=' + encodeURIComponent(chatUserId) : null avatarHtml = '' // the photo dialog's: the photo as it is, larger photoAvatarHtml = '' const tabs = [['overview', 'Overview'], ['activity', 'Activity'], ['calendar', 'Calendar'], ['tasks', 'Tasks'], ['requests', 'Requests'], ['files', 'Files'], ['consent', 'Consent']] tabsHtml = '' + tabs.map(([key, label]) => { const url = linkTo({partyId: recordPartyId, tab: key}) // with the chatter column, Activity is a tab only below 1440 px const cls = key === 'activity' && chatterColumn && tab !== 'activity' ? ' class="lt-lg"' : '' return '' }).join('') + '' // the actions that need the shell: new event and new task on the contact (quick create with the record of the screen context) const quick = (kind, label, icon) => '' quickHtml = quick('event', 'New event', 'sym_o_event') + quick('task', 'New task', 'sym_o_task_alt') composeUrl = record.primaryEmail ? '/qapps/Comms/Inbox/Compose?' + moqui_query({to: record.primaryEmail, recordEntity: 'mantle.party.Party', recordId: recordPartyId}) : null function moqui_query(params) { return Object.keys(params).map((key) => encodeURIComponent(key) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(params[key])).join('&') } showExpiredUrl = linkTo({partyId: recordPartyId, tab: 'overview', showExpired: showExpired == 'Y' ? null : 'Y'}) expiredText = showExpired == 'Y' ? L('Hide expired') : ec.resource.expand('Show expired (${count})', '', {count: rec.expiredCount || 0}) const anchor = (href, text, cls) => '' + enc(text) + '' const mLink = (href, text, cls) => '' + enc(text) + '' // each kind's primary one (Mantle's get#PartyContactInfo) first and in bold contactMechList = (rec.contactMechList || []).map((mech) => Object.assign({}, mech, {linkHtml: mech.href && !mech.expired ? anchor(mech.href, mech.value, mech.isPrimary ? 'text-weight-medium' : '') : null, detailText: [mech.typeLabel, mech.purposeText].filter((part) => part).join(' · ')})) addressList = rec.addressList || [] organizationList = rec.organizationList || [] relationshipList = rec.relationshipList || [] bookList = rec.bookList || [] otherBookList = rec.otherBookList || [] noteList = rec.noteList || [] employeeCard = rec.employeeCard || null personalBanner = isPersonal ? ec.resource.expand(record.personalBookText ? 'Private · in ${books}' : 'Private · only you see this contact', '', {books: record.personalBookText}) : null roleText = (rec.roleList || []).map((role) => role.description).join(', ') captionText = [record.kindLabel, record.pseudoId, roleText].filter((part) => part).join(' · ') eventList = (act.eventList || []).map((event) => Object.assign({}, event, {linkHtml: mLink(event.url, event.title)})) taskList = (act.taskList || []).map((task) => Object.assign({}, task, {linkHtml: mLink(task.url, task.workEffortName, task.closed ? 'm-muted' : '')})) requestList = (act.requestList || []).map((request) => Object.assign({}, request, {linkHtml: mLink(request.url, request.requestName)})) isConsentAdmin = !!access.isContactAdmin mergedToPartyId = rec.mergedToPartyId bookOptions = otherBookList.map((book) => ({key: book.contactBookId, text: book.contactBookName + (book.isOwner ? '' : ' · ' + L('shared'))})) favoriteBookId = record.favoriteBookId
